text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After concluding a fierce battle against 
TM Opera O, Narita Top Road, and Meisho 
Doto—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"Racing against rivals is uncontrollably 
fun." Admire Vega savors that feeling 
deeply.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She spoke once again—not for anyone else, 
but about her own personal vision of 
becoming a "proud big sister."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To seize every gleam of glory and become a 
"first-magnitude star" whose brilliance 
reaches even the farthest corners—that was 
her goal.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If that's the case, then to a race of 
suitable caliber. Together, they decided 
on the "Tenno Sho (Autumn)" for their next 
race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Not to dedicate it to anyone else, but 
simply toward wherever her own heart and 
legs decide. Admire Vega takes another 
step forward.
